# Step 5 tables (generated by comparison/explain/graph_types/step5_label_smoothing.py)

Test fold, descriptive, nothing selected. `del` = deletion_mean_change_vs_random, per visit averaged over the 3 seeds (a visit counts for a key/source when ok in >= 2 seeds). Differences are paired on the same visit; 95% CIs are patient-cluster bootstrap percentiles (2000 draws, seed 20261025, resampling the 1000 patients). `raw` = plain mean difference; `adj` = confidence-adjusted: the global slope of the difference on the confidence difference (predicted-class probability of the two models, seed-averaged) is refit in every draw and the stratum value is evaluated at the sample-average confidence difference. Cells under 10 visits are not printed; cells under 30 visits are shown with n only (not interpreted).

Class groups: Cardiovascular = Heart failure, Non-ST elevation (NSTEMI) myocardial infarction, Unspecified atrial fibrillation; Infection and respiratory = Sepsis, UTI or pyelonephritis, Skin or soft-tissue infection, Lower respiratory disease, Acute pharyngitis; Metabolic renal blood = Acute kidney failure, Diabetes mellitus, Hypokalemia, Anemia; Gastrointestinal = GI bleed, Unsp intestnl obst; Injury and pain = Back or spine pain, Limb injury or pain, Head injury; Neuro psychiatric substance = Epilepsy, Major depressive disorder, Alcohol abuse with intoxication.

Visits with a usable `del` per key/source: graphcare/GNNExp 1344 of 1345.

## A. Label-smoothing cost: del(cei_final) - del(cei_R1_ls0), by graph type

Negative = label smoothing lowers the score. `share of cost` = the stratum's summed cost divided by the summed cost over all visits (strata of one feature add to 100%; a share above the stratum's visit share means the cost concentrates there). Confidence change (cei_final - cei_R1_ls0 predicted-class probability), all visits: -0.0894.

## C. Multivariable linear model (weighted least squares, patient-cluster bootstrap)

Target = the paired per-visit difference (CEI - partner, or cei_final - cei_R1 for the LS cost). Predictors: seven standardized graph features (n_nodes, density, num_visits, n_prior_dx, measurement share of evidence nodes, number of complaint nodes, number of knowledge nodes; the number of diagnosis nodes equals n_prior_dx in every visit and is not entered twice), the standardized confidence difference of the two models, and five class-group indicators (reference: Infection and respiratory; indicator coefficients are offsets in `del`, the others are per 1 SD). Coefficients are refit on each of the 2000 patient-cluster draws; `*` marks a 95% CI that excludes 0. Variance inflation factors (representative design, cei_final vs GSAT IG): z_n_nodes 8.6, z_density 28.6, z_num_visits 5.8, z_n_prior_dx 7.2, z_measurement_share 20.7, z_n_complaint_nodes 1.3, z_n_knowledge_nodes 11.2, z_conf_diff 1.3, class: Cardiovascular (vs Infection and respiratory) 1.2, class: Metabolic renal blood (vs Infection and respiratory) 1.2, class: Gastrointestinal (vs Infection and respiratory) 1.2, class: Injury and pain (vs Infection and respiratory) 1.4, class: Neuro psychiatric substance (vs Infection and respiratory) 1.3. n_nodes, density, measurement share and n_knowledge_nodes move together; read their coefficients jointly, not one by one.

## D. Depth <= 2 rule summary, min leaf 50 visits, checked on a patient-level held-out split

For each target the visits are split by patient into a training half and a held-out half (500 patients each; 5 random splits, seeds 20261025+0..4). A greedy least-squares tree (candidate cuts at the 5%..95% quantiles of the training half) is grown on the training half; leaf means are then recomputed on the held-out half with patient-cluster CIs. Held-out R^2 = 1 - SSE(tree leaf means from the training half) / SSE(training-half overall mean), both on the held-out visits (0 = no better than a constant, negative = worse). Descriptive: rules are not used to select anything. Leaf table shown for split 0; `R^2` lists all splits.
